description: This Java class is a data validator for self-beneficiary transfer payment transactions. It validates JSON input for creating and updating beneficiary details such as name, office name, account number, account type, and transfer limit. It uses helper classes to parse JSON and build validation errors.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that performs validation of JSON payloads for creating and updating self-beneficiary transfer payment entities.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for creating a new beneficiary, ensuring required fields are present and valid, and returns a map of validated parameters.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing beneficiary, allowing partial updates, and returns a map of validated parameters.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if validation errors are present after validation checks.
